description: Queue a supported Instagram, Facebook, YouTube or X link in Skwirl. Requires an authenticated Skwirl connection and the user's intent to save the link; do not use just to read it. Writes a capture for asynchronous processing; success says the note should be ready in a few minutes, not that it is ready now. An existing normalized link in this account returns 'Already saved.' without replacing its reminder. Unsupported links, permission/plan restrictions or queue limits return explanatory failure text. Use search_stash or recent_stash to find a processed note later. Usage examples: save_link({"url":"https://www.instagram.com/reel/ABC123/","note":"Try this recipe"}). Returns text.

note.description: Optional free-text string, up to 500 characters, explaining why the user wants to save this link; omit if not supplied. Example: Try this recipe.

url.description: HTTPS URL string for a supported Instagram, Facebook, YouTube or X post. Example: https://www.instagram.com/reel/ABC123/.

name: save_link
